day_shape: 69 items in an active US-Iran conflict cycle: Pezeshkian at SCO signals openness to reviving June interim deal, CENTCOM rebuts IRGC mine claim in Hormuz, IDF strikes Gaza City after alleged militia infiltration, FinCEN proposes 311 measure on Banque Misr UAE, EASA extends Gulf airspace warning to 30 Sept.

threads.label: US-Iran conflict and diplomatic signalling
threads.summary: Pezeshkian told the SCO summit and Tasnim that Iran would reciprocate if Washington returned to the June interim deal, while a senior Iranian source told Reuters the confrontation remained "limited and contained." Trump posted that "Iran is officially a Failed Nation" a day after US strikes on Iranian military assets, and a Jerusalem Post-cited poll put his approval at a career low over the Iran war.

threads.label: Hormuz, Gulf shipping and US posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM publicly rebutted an IRGC claim that a supertanker had struck two mines in the southern Strait of Hormuz, calling it disinformation, and EASA extended its warning to airlines to avoid Gulf airspace over Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and the UAE until 30 September. Iran International reported IRGC Unit 4000 was recruiting non-Iranian operatives to attack shipping in East Asia including two Chinese ports, while VP Vance said the war showed Iran's leadership was willing to disrupt Gulf oil and gas flow.

threads.label: Gaza City strikes and alleged militia raid
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed strikes on "several targets" in Gaza City to remove threats to security forces, with Palestinian media reporting at least one killed after what was described as an Israeli-backed anti-Hamas militia infiltrated the western part of the city. Defence Minister Katz said a senior Hamas member was captured in the raid, and the IDF separately announced the killing of Hamas supply commander Omar Mohammed Roshdy Saraj in Sabra.

threads.label: Iran economic strain from the war
threads.summary: Central Bank governor Hemmati told parliament Iran was ready to inject up to $2 billion to stabilise the rial as the dollar traded around 2.1 million rials, and customs data showed non-oil exports and imports down roughly a quarter since the US conflict began. Iran Khodro and Saipa's accumulated losses reached about 340 trillion tomans, Iran International reported gunfire against jobseeker protests in the southwest, and Pezeshkian's son publicly questioned whether enrichment was worth its wartime costs.

threads.label: Khamenei office messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed a Government Week and Unity Week message cycle urging "no discord" and "one Iran one nation," and announced pardons or commutations for over 2,570 convicts marking the Prophet's and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq's birthdays. Defa Press and IRIB carried parallel Air Defence Day statements from Chief of Staff Gen. Abdollahi and Army chief Gen. Hatami on upgrading electronic and cyber warfare capabilities.

threads.label: US financial and sanctions actions
threads.summary: FinCEN issued a notice of proposed rulemaking under section 311 of the USA PATRIOT Act finding five UAE-based branches of Banque Misr to be of primary money laundering concern and proposing to bar US correspondent accounts. OCHA's July humanitarian update for Iran recorded strikes on 13 consecutive nights from 12-24 July mainly in southern provinces and coastal regions.

threads.label: Regime narrative of US defeat
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a coordinated set of items claiming US failure, including that Adm. Daryl Cudal said US Navy forces would not return to Bahrain in the near future, that a US Deputy Secretary of Defence's resignation showed American defeat, and citing Politico and the BBC on Republican fatigue with Trump's Iran policy. Brig. Ahmadi-Moghadam claimed many countries were accepting a "Strong Iran," and Sen. Mark Kelly was cited criticising the Trump-Netanyahu war.

events.title_en: Pardon and commutation of sentences for over 2,500 convicts on the occasion of the Prophet's birth and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq's birth
events.summary_en: Pardon and commutation of sentences for over 2,500 convicts on the occasion of the Prophet's birth and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq's birth. Coinciding with the blessed days of the birth of Prophet Muhammad al-Mustafa (Peace Be Upon Him) and Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (Peace Be Upon Him), the head of the judiciary in a letter to the Supreme Leader requested pardon, commutation and alteration of sentences for 2,577 convicts from public and revolutionary courts, the judiciary organisation of the armed forces and the government punishment organisation, which His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Husseini Khamenei delegated decision-making in this matter to the head of the judiciary. Hojjat al-Islam wal-Muslimin Ajeha, after necessary review, issued an order to execute the pardon, commutation and alteration of sentences for these convicts.
